title: Algerian Lamb Tagine with Roasted Vegetables
description: A twist on traditional Chinese cuisine, this dish combines the bold flavors of Algerian tagine with the tender lamb, all while incorporating roasted vegetables for added depth.
instructions: Toss the lamb shoulder with olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Add the roasted red peppers, eggplant, and carrots to the oven and roast for an additional 15 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the Algerian tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Add the roasted vegetables to the skillet and stir to combine.
Serve the lamb and vegetables hot, garnished with parsley and cilantro.
Cook time may vary depending on the size and thickness of the lamb shoulder.
